title: feat(console-ai): an AI build shows the app itself in the main area, with one Publish on screen
body:
Fixes #34610

Implements ui ADR-0057 Amendment A3 and ADR-0037 as amended (#34640, merged), on top of #34665 (merged). Ruling 6937505798 on #34610.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用 AI 搭建时，聊天留在右侧抽屉，主区域直接显示正在搭建的应用，并随每个草稿件原地刷新。嵌套的 Live Canvas iframe 和分屏去掉了。新应用（已物化、未上架）按 ADR-0045 显示为真实应用，由「尚未发布」条发布；已发布应用的改动在 `?preview=draft` 中显示，由草稿栏发布。整屏只有一个发布按钮，聊天里不再有发布按钮，只给指引，发布后在聊天里显示回执。计数统一为当前应用包的待发布改动。Studio 副驾的放大改为原地加宽，不再跳到 `/ai/build`。
- 为什么改：#34610 的「同意」裁定（6937505798）；ADR 依据 #34640（A3「Building」「One publish control」「One container」）。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台前端（app-shell、plugin-chatbot 一个可选 prop、i18n 新键），不动元数据、契约和服务端。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`console/ai/mainAreaDraft.ts`（主区去向与两种发布形态）、`AiChatPage.tsx` 的 ChatPane 主区块（只在进行中的回合移动、跨页移动等回合结束）、`PendingDraftsBar.tsx`、`preview/DraftPreviewBar.tsx`（按包计数、按包发布、不再整页刷新）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/mainAreaDraft-34610.test.ts packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.draftInMainArea-34610.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/PendingDraftsBar.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/preview/__tests__/DraftPreviewBar.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/__tests__/studioCopilotWidenInPlace-34610.test.tsx`，预期全部通过。

## What changes

**The app shows in the main area** (`console/ai/mainAreaDraft.ts`, `AiChatPage.tsx`)
- `mainAreaDraftMove(target, here, inPlace)` decides where the main area goes. It stays on the current page when the drawer sits beside the app being built, and otherwise opens `/apps/<package>`. Changes to a published app get `?preview=draft`. A materialized build shows the real app, and if it leaves draft mode the sticky preview keeper is told (`markPreviewExit`).
- ChatPane moves the main area only for drafts reported during a turn it is streaming:
  - a move to another page waits for the turn to end, so the stream in flight is not cut;
  - a conversation reopened from history moves nothing;
  - a new build moves in only after its package binds (A1).
- Each drafted artifact emits one coalesced `emitCanvasInvalidate` per type (200 ms), the per-artifact refresh of ADR-0037 Phase 2. `emitMetadataRefresh` runs once more when the turn ends.
- Removed: `LiveCanvas.tsx`, the split pane, the resizable chat width, the mobile canvas pill and overlay. The dock's auto-maximize latch (`maximize`/`restore`, driven by the canvas) is removed from `ChatDock.tsx` and `ChatDockConversation.tsx`.

**One Publish on screen**
- `ChatbotEnhanced` takes `publishFromShellBar`. When set, the draft cards draw no Publish; Preview, the Published badge and auto-publish stay.
- `PendingDraftsBar` no longer publishes. While the main area shows this package's draft it says "N unpublished changes. Publish them from the draft bar at the top." Otherwise it offers **Show draft**.
- A publish from the draft bar or the unpublished-app bar emits `emitPublishReceipt` (assistant bus). The chat shows "Published. Your changes are live." until drafts are pending again or the receipt is dismissed.

**One count, two wordings**
- `DraftPreviewBar`, `DraftChangesPanel` and the chat read the current app's package drafts (`_drafts?package=`). The bar's separate "on this page" count is gone (`draftSurface.ts` keeps only the deep-link path).
- The draft bar publishes that package (`publishAll({ packageId })`) and no longer reloads the page, so the drawer conversation and the receipt survive.
- New wordings: `preview.unpublishedBar.notPublishedYet` ("This app is not published yet…") and `preview.draftBar.pendingInApp` ("N unpublished changes in this app", with plural forms).

**Studio copilot**
- Expand widens the copilot's slot in place (`StudioRightSlot` `wideWidth`) and the same button restores. It no longer navigates to `/ai/build?package=…` (A3 "One container").
- Without a drawer host there is no main area to move, so the copilot's cards draw no Preview, and Studio's own top bar publishes.

**i18n.** New keys in all 11 packs (zh-Hant regenerated): `preview.draftBar.pendingInApp`, `preview.unpublishedBar.notPublishedYet`, and `console.ai.pendingDrafts.publishFromBar` / `showDraftToPublish` (plurals), `showDraft`, `receipt`, `dismissReceipt`. No existing value changed. The changeset lists the keys the console no longer reads.

## Why

Ruling 6937505798 on #34610: "the build happens in the same right drawer with the app draft itself in the main area; no nested preview; one publish button and one change count." #34640's contract review added the ADR-0045 regimes (a new app is materialized and published by its own bar) and the Studio in-place maximize.

## Verification

- Affected test dirs (app-shell `console/ai`, `preview`, `layout`, `views/studio-design`, `chrome`, and `plugin-chatbot`): 698 files, 5378 tests, all green after one fix. `PendingDraftsBar.sentenceWraps-13088` had pinned a plural form that a test with no i18n instance cannot draw; its assertion is now plural-agnostic.
- Type-check: app-shell `tsc -p tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json` exit 0, plugin-chatbot `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 0. After merging main: app-shell `tsconfig.test.json` exit 0, and the i18n suite plus the new tests pass (105 files).
- eslint on every changed ts/tsx file: 0 errors.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: all 51 derived families run, 0 not measured. First-run reds and how each was answered:
  - The ui `scripts/` suite still listed `LiveCanvas.test.tsx` in the dom-heavy list. Fixed in `ui/vitest.config.mts`.
  - `check:test-source-alias`: two edited preview tests needed a module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'`. Added.
  - Two spec gates ran before a gitignored generated file existed. Re-run exit 0.
  - `check:dts-closure` needed a console build. Re-run exit 0.
- overlap-check: `origin/main` merged cleanly. The only open-PR conflict, with #34628 in `ConsoleLayout.tsx`, came from #34665 and is resolved there.
- The branch was cut from #34665's head. #34665 was squash-merged, so its final head and then `main` were merged in. The diff against `main` equals the pre-merge #34610 diff, line for line (64 files, +1316 −2556).

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (The 维护者速读 block is the seat's maintainer summary.)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
